ownBranchShare.labelMeaning: Our share of identified source branch inventory; not sales market share, capacity, customers or verified operating branches
ownBranchShare.denominator: Own + identified competitor branch records within the same selected industry/format/license scope, geography and source basis
ownBranchShare.exactZeroDenominator: Count0 is known; share is null/undefined_ratio, not0%. The renderer uses an explicit empty-basis state.
ownBranchShare.validZeroPercent: Own0 and competitor>0 means a measured0% proxy
ownBranchShare.validHundredPercent: Own>0 and competitor0 means100% of the identified inventory only
ownBranchShare.uncertainty: Scope/licence/allocation/reconciliation uncertainty stays review; expose conservative bounds with zero-denominator edge handling and never paint as an exact ratio. boundsKnown=false retains review0..100, not a guessed point.
ownBranchShare.aggregateRule: Ratio from one compatible raw parent vector; never average local ratios, percentiles or sum ambiguous fine display links.

coverage.unclassified: Non-bank licence/scope evidence not yet resolved; keep separate and conservative comparison bounds
coverage.excluded: Exact known source dimensions outside selected format/license scope; not missing evidence

coverage.treemapInReview: Observed source count rectangles may remain with visible incomplete/review caption; percentages withheld. No residual, upper-bound allocation or inferred branch is plotted.

nonbank.limit: Top10 selectable identities do not truncate competitors. Licence family is potential company scope, not branch-level offering; preserve assignment residual and licence uncertainty.

industryEvidence.commonLimits: Source inventory, source time and display geometry remain evidence-specific; coordinates and team POI edits never substitute for native area totals.

treemap.areaMeaning: Each rectangle area represents its observed source branch-count fraction; not sales/physical capacity or uncertain upper-bound share
treemap.panelGrouping: Keep positive own row +8 largest identified competitors + Other when needed; Other is an exact sum with inspectable named members
treemap.hoverGrouping: Compact count composition with exact Other aggregation and own row retained when positive
treemap.brandListCompleteness: A readable nonspatial list explicitly reveals additional40-row batches; no silent record truncation
